subject: SOC 2 recertification — phased evidence delivery + temporary capacity bump
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-fin.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara.singh@acme-fin.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 recert request + retention ask (renewal)

Hi Sofia,

We're kicking off our vendor recertification for the July renewal and need to coordinate ACME's SOC 2 attestation items. Security wants the SOC 2 evidence bundle, an archive of the last 12 months of audit logs, and confirmation of your retention SLA for logs and backups.

Two constraints on our side:
- Our security ops team can only ingest large evidence deliveries in a phased way (max 250GB/week).
- Procurement needs to confirm any contract amendments if retention or SLA terms change.

Can Redwood support a phased evidence upload (staged manifest + weekly handoff) and a temporary 30% burst of capacity to help ingest logs during the handoff window? If yes, we also need a short amendment showing the retention term change and any one-time credits for the ingestion work.

I've attached an initial CSV manifest of files we expect to receive. Let us know next steps, timelines, and contacts on your side for legal/finance.

Thanks,
Daniel
Security Program Manager
Acme Financial
Attachment: SOC2_evidence_manifest.csv

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert request + retention ask (renewal)

Thanks Daniel — appreciate the clear constraints. We can support a phased evidence delivery and the temporary capacity bump you describe. Proposed approach: 

1) Phased evidence delivery (recommended):
   - Week 1: configuration & process docs + 50GB sample set (verification)
   - Weeks 2–4: bulk evidence in 250GB chunks (per your ops cadence)
   - Final week: reconciliation report + signed manifest

2) Temporary capacity:
   - Provision a 30% burst pool for 4 weeks to soak ingestion, then scale back (we can extend if needed)

3) Contract amendment items we need to capture:
   - Temporary retention window increase from 90 -> 180 days for audit logs (scope + dates)
   - One-time ingestion credit to offset bulk transfer labor (we typically propose a credit equal to 10% of one month committed spend for first-time bulk handoffs)

I'll loop in Jonas (legal & pricing) and Laura (customer success/renewals) to draft the amendment and the timeline. Can you confirm: target start week (Mon) for the phased handoff and whether your ops team prefers SFTP vs. shared GCS bucket?

Best,
Sofia
Director, Customer Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachment: log-upload-instructions.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-fin.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert request + retention ask (renewal)

Daniel — thanks for the manifest. From pricing/legal perspective:

- We're amenable to the 30% burst for a 4-week window. We'll treat that as a temporary capacity overlay; it won't change the committed baseline but will be reflected in the amendment as an agreed burst period.
- For the ingestion credit, Sofia's proposal (10% of one month committed spend) is reasonable as a starting point. If ACME prefers a fixed credit number, please propose and we'll evaluate.
- The retention change (90 -> 180 days) is material. Legal needs the exact effective dates and whether this is a permanent change or a temporary carveout for the handoff window.

Action items for ACME please:
1) Confirm preferred start date (local TZ).
2) Confirm transfer method (SFTP or GCS).
3) Indicate if the retention change should be permanent or a timeboxed exception.

I'll have a draft amendment ready for review within 48 business hours once we have those answers. Karthik, please standby to update billing terms and create the one-off credit line if we agree.

— Jonas
VP, Legal & Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@acme-fin.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-fin.com>, procurement <procurement@acme-fin.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert request + retention ask (renewal)

Hi Jonas/Sofia,

Thanks — we confirm the following from ACME side:
- Preferred start: Monday, July 5, 2027 (our ops will be ready to accept the first 50GB sample that day).
- Transfer method: GCS signed-bucket (preferred). We'll provide a temporary service account with read/write for the window.
- Retention change: timeboxed exception for the handoff; effective July 5 -> August 2, 2027. After August 2 logs revert to 90-day retention unless we agree otherwise.
- For ingestion credit: ACME prefers a fixed credit applied to the July invoice — request: $8,500 one-time credit for migration support.

I'll await the amendment draft and DocuSign. Also include a contact in billing for the credit.

Best,
Tara Singh
Head of Vendor Security Operations
Acme Financial

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@acme-fin.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, procurement <procurement@acme-fin.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 15:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert request + retention ask (renewal)

Tara / Daniel — thanks for the quick confirmations. Next steps from Redwood:

1) Jonas will circulate a short amendment PDF capturing:
   - Timeboxed retention exception: 2027-07-05 -> 2027-08-02
   - Temporary 30% burst capacity for 4 weeks (no change to committed baseline)
   - One-time ingestion credit: $8,500 applied to July invoice

2) Legal & ACME to review amendment; we'll push the DocuSign link once finalized.

3) Operational handoff: Sofia will coordinate the GCS bucket details and share the upload playbook (see attached log-upload-instructions.pdf).

4) Billing: Karthik will create the credit line and confirm the invoice amendment; he will follow up with procurement.

If that aligns, expect the draft amendment from Jonas by end of day tomorrow. Sofia — please confirm you'll set up the onboarding session with ACME ops on July 5 (15-minute sync + test upload).

Thanks — excited to keep the renewal on track.

Laura Bennett
Head of Renewals
Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed-amendment-draft.pdf
